gbm_population_evidence.quote: Diagnosed with anti-GBM disease. Positive anti-GBM antibodies at screening, with or without ANCA antibody positivity.

candidate_evidence.quote: An open-label, single-arm Phase II study to evaluate the preliminary efficacy, safety, pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics and immunogenicity of KJ103 in patients with anti-GBM disease.

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Maximum observed serum concentration of KJ103 following dosing (Cmax)

role_evidence.quote: Subjects will administered KJ103 intravenously on D1 and adjunctively on D8

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational IgG-degrading biologic for autoimmune anti-GBM disease (not antitumour)

role_evidence.quote: KJ103 +SOC(SoC consists of a standardized combination of PE, Cyclophosphamide, and glucocorticoids)

agents.drug_class_hint: alkylating immunosuppressant (standard of care for anti-GBM disease)

coder_notes: 'GBM' here is anti-glomerular basement membrane disease, not glioblastoma; excluded at S5. No antitumour agent: KJ103 is the experimental agent in the arm (role recorded as experimental_monotherapy for its trial role) but it is an autoimmune therapy with no antitumour purpose, so has_eligible_candidate is false. Treatment setting not applicable to a tumour, coded unclear. PK is serum only; PD markers (serum IgG, ANCA) are not antitumour target engagement.
